title: Debuggy; Blocks & Items
description: A mod that adds unused/removed blocks and items. Everything is purely cosmetic.
body:
Did you ever want to have that missing texture block? Did you ever want to hold the unused crystallized honey? Did you ever want to use those nice top and/or bottom textures of work stations? Well, then Debuggy is the mod for **YOU,** pal! **:DDD**
